title: Apple calendar has good design but good not for sync with other platform
body:
I think that Apple calendar has good software design, simple, user friendly and it is can also extract documents, photos, videos from Apple File app. If you are an Apple user and you are using Apple File app then it would be great for you to use this Apple calendar which is a part of the same Apple platform. 

But all calendars just look the same way and have the same functions as well. I just do not know why Apple calendar is good amount all of the choices. Is it replaceable? Yes.
Moreover, it would be a problem if you want your calendar to sync with other platforms.
